title: A log is a cylinder with cut ends, never a row of spheres
note: A log is a cylinder with cut ends, never a row of spheres; foliage.js makeLog/makeLogPile.
intent: A felled log built from six ovoids reads as a caterpillar. A log is a cylinder with a slight taper, a darker cut face at each end, and bark from a material map rather than geometry. A pile is those cylinders crossed and stacked with a little rotation jitter so no two lie parallel, resting on each other rather than floating. foliage.js makeLog({ length, radius, bark }) and makeLogPile({ seed, bark }) build both.

check.js: (() => { const logs = [...objects('log'), ...objects('log-pile'), ...objects('firewood')]; if (!logs.length) return true; let bad = 0; for (const l of logs) l.traverse(m => { if (m.isMesh && /Sphere|Icosahedron|Dodecahedron|Octahedron/.test(m.geometry?.type ?? '')) bad++; }); return bad === 0; })()
check.detail: (() => { const logs = [...objects('log'), ...objects('log-pile'), ...objects('firewood')]; let bad = 0; for (const l of logs) l.traverse(m => { if (m.isMesh && /Sphere|Icosahedron|Dodecahedron|Octahedron/.test(m.geometry?.type ?? '')) bad++; }); return 'logs: ' + logs.length + ', sphere-built log meshes: ' + bad; })()

port: Anything tagged log, log-pile or firewood comes from makeLog / makeLogPile, or from a modelled asset.
